{'name':'f','params':[['x','I']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':['eq',v('x'),c('I',5)]},
{'name':'g','params':[['y','I']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':None}]
pipes=[{'target':'e','filter':'f','bind':{'x':'extra'}},{'target':'f','filter':'g','bind':{'y':'x'}}]

 return o
